active_export_concern.assessment: The source path uses the bounded campaign-slice descendant cgroup scan and requires the populated-process map to be empty before staging or score submission. The reviewed exporter uses create-only output creation; the score path preserves stable input identity/hash validation and writes its result create-only. Together with root's no-restart execution policy, these gates address the active-export overlap concern without querying an old or stopped export unit.
active_export_concern.decision_source: Root execution review: ALL-populated-empty slice gate before mutation, create-only export outputs, stable scorer input hashes, and no unit restarts. This review made no live-state assertion.

actual_authority_and_render_state.required_future_action: Create a later versioned score-admission packet that binds the ultimately accepted exporter/scorer pair, its actual export identity, root-owned acceptance, and exact-stop after a successful complete export. Do not bind the failed export-v2 observation as export authority.

reviewer_conclusion: V7 closes the reviewed V6 missing-inventory gap: it requires an exact live source file and directory closure, rejects unlisted code/runtime files, symlinks, and non-regular entries before hashing the manifest files, and leaves the remainder of the V6 body unchanged. The active-export concern is addressed by the source-preserving ALL-populated-empty gate plus create-only and stable-hash protections; a separate old-unit query is not required. This is a conditional source review only. V7 remains tied to historical export-v2/V3 producer pins with acceptance and exact-stop null, so it cannot be rendered or used as actual score admission; a future packet must rebind the successful export authority.
